system.description:
Spend 1 Luck Point (a Luck symbol just rolled or a banked point) to turn the Doom Clock back 1 minute, instead of needing 2 Luck symbols.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.57
system.summary: Spend 1 Luck Point (a Luck symbol just rolled or a banked point) to turn the Doom Clock back 1 minute, instead of needing 2 Luck symbols.

automation.note: Use spends 1 banked Luck Point. To spend a Luck symbol you just rolled, Use after the check resolves; if that symbol was lost to a full bank, add 1 back to your bank afterwards.
